ticker_news.title: 5 Tech Stocks You Can Buy and Hold for the Next Decade
ticker_news.description: The article recommends five technology stocks to buy and hold for the next decade: Nvidia, Alphabet, Netflix, Amazon, and Microsoft. These companies are well-positioned to benefit from growth trends in artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and other emerging technologies.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

ticker_news.title: Netflix: Why Stock Could Keep Hitting All-Time Highs
ticker_news.description: Netflix's subscriber growth and price hike plans have sent its stock soaring, and the company's expansion into live events and ad-based tiers suggest further upside potential.
ticker_news.author: Marketbeat.Com
